source_claim: Blizzard’s official Overwatch news article identifies Pink Mercy as an Overwatch skin, and names Dr. Angela Ziegler, codename Mercy, as the Overwatch character whose skin it is.
notes: Checked the official Blizzard announcement at https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/21758132/. It explicitly ties the Pink Mercy skin to Overwatch and Mercy. Only the current campaign tag pink_mercy is included; no other variant/skin identity is inferred.
